title: Hook Install Payload Schema
description: Output shape of `qdev install hooks --json`. Reports installed git hook shims and any preserved legacy hooks. Schema changes follow semver on schema_version; additive fields do not bump the major.

hooks_dir.description: Absolute or relative path to the Git hooks directory.

installed_hooks.description: Names of hook shims written or updated in the hooks directory.

preserved_legacy.description: Names of preexisting non-qdev hooks renamed to <name>.legacy.
